## Publication Information

**Date:** 1889

**Genre:** Fiction (historical)

**Publisher:** National Society’s Depository, Broad Sanctuary, London.

**Notes:** Leeds University Library has <i>A Tale of Cheddar Caves One Hundred Years Ago</i>, with illustrations by W. S. Stacey, published in Wells: Dowman Woodhams n.d, which is presumably a reprint of this book.
